meaning.en: To leave room for manoeuvre; not to go to extremes.
meaning.zh: 说话、做事不走极端，留下可以回旋的地方。

examples.zh: 说话要留有余地，别把话说死。
examples.en: Leave yourself some leeway — don't say anything you can't take back.

examples.zh: 制定计划时要留有余地。
examples.en: Build some slack into your plans.

examples.zh: 批评孩子也要留有余地。
examples.en: Even when you scold a child, don't go too far.

meaning.en: To mutter or murmur to oneself.
meaning.zh: 小声地自己跟自己说话。

equivalents: talk to oneself under one's breath

examples.zh: 老人坐在门口喃喃自语。
examples.en: The old man sat in the doorway muttering to himself.

examples.zh: 她一边找钥匙一边喃喃自语。
examples.en: She muttered to herself as she looked for her keys.

examples.zh: 考试前他喃喃自语地背着公式。
examples.en: Before the exam he was reciting formulas under his breath.

meaning.en: Superficial efforts made only for show.
meaning.zh: 只做在表面上、不解决实际问题的工作。

examples.zh: 环保工作不能只做表面文章。
examples.en: Environmental protection can't just be window dressing.

examples.zh: 检查组一来就打扫卫生，这是做表面文章。
examples.en: Cleaning up only when the inspectors come is just for show.

examples.zh: 这些改革措施全是表面文章。
examples.en: These reforms are nothing but box-ticking.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“做表面文章”。

pinyin: shén bù zhī guǐ bù jué
literal: gods · not · know · ghosts · not · sense

meaning.en: So secretly that no one at all notices.
meaning.zh: 连神鬼都不知道，形容做事极其隐秘。

examples.zh: 他神不知鬼不觉地把钱转走了。
examples.en: He moved the money out without anyone noticing.

examples.zh: 小偷神不知鬼不觉地溜进了屋子。
examples.en: The thief slipped into the house without a sound.

examples.zh: 我们神不知鬼不觉地给她准备了生日惊喜。
examples.en: We secretly prepared a birthday surprise for her, and she had no idea.

usage.en: Adverbial; usually 神不知鬼不觉地.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“神不知鬼不觉地”。

meaning.en: Every word and sentence; carefully, word by word.
meaning.zh: 每一个字、每一句话，形容认真仔细。

examples.zh: 老师一字一句地给我们讲解课文。
examples.en: The teacher went through the text with us word by word.

examples.zh: 他一字一句地说：“我不同意。”
examples.en: He said slowly and deliberately, 'I do not agree.'

examples.zh: 这份合同我一字一句都看过了。
examples.en: I've read every single word of this contract.

usage.en: Adverbial or subject; often 一字一句地.

meaning.en: To give up on oneself and make no effort to improve.
meaning.zh: 自己甘心落后，不求上进。

examples.zh: 一次失败不算什么，千万别自暴自弃。
examples.en: One failure is nothing — don't give up on yourself.

examples.zh: 失业后他自暴自弃，整天喝酒。
examples.en: After losing his job he let himself go and drank all day.

examples.zh: 老师不放弃任何一个自暴自弃的学生。
examples.en: The teacher never gives up on a student who has given up on himself.

story.en: Mencius: 'Those who do violence to themselves cannot be reasoned with; those who throw themselves away cannot be helped to act' (自暴者，不可与有言也；自弃者，不可与有为也).
story.zh: 《孟子·离娄上》：“自暴者，不可与有言也；自弃者，不可与有为也。”

meaning.en: Willing to do something but lacking the strength or means.
meaning.zh: 有想法却没有能力去做。

equivalents: the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak

examples.zh: 我很想帮你，可是有心无力。
examples.en: I'd love to help, but I just can't.

examples.zh: 年纪大了，很多事有心无力。
examples.en: At my age there's a lot I'd like to do but can't.

examples.zh: 小公司想做研发，往往有心无力。
examples.en: Small firms want to invest in R&D but often lack the means.

meaning.en: To lack public support; to be unpopular.
meaning.zh: 得不到众人的支持和拥护。

examples.zh: 这项政策不得人心，很快就被取消了。
examples.en: The policy was unpopular and soon scrapped.

examples.zh: 他在公司里专横霸道，很不得人心。
examples.en: He's domineering at work and deeply unpopular.

examples.zh: 不得人心的政府终会垮台。
examples.en: A government without popular support will eventually fall.

meaning.en: To hoard scarce goods and sell them at inflated prices.
meaning.zh: 把紧缺的货物大量储存起来，等待高价出售。

examples.zh: 疫情期间，有商家囤积居奇，哄抬口罩价格。
examples.en: During the pandemic, some traders hoarded masks and pushed up prices.

examples.zh: 政府严厉打击囤积居奇的行为。
examples.en: The government is cracking down hard on hoarding and profiteering.

examples.zh: 开发商囤积居奇，捂盘惜售。
examples.en: Developers are holding back flats to drive up prices.

meaning.en: Brilliantly colourful and splendid.
meaning.zh: 色彩鲜艳，丰富多彩。

examples.zh: 秋天的山林绚丽多彩。
examples.en: The autumn woods are a riot of colour.

examples.zh: 祝你的大学生活绚丽多彩！
examples.en: May your university years be colourful and rewarding!

examples.zh: 民族服饰绚丽多彩，让游客大开眼界。
examples.en: The vibrant ethnic costumes were an eye-opener for the visitors.

meaning.en: To do wrong knowing full well that it is wrong.
meaning.zh: 明明知道不对，还故意去做。

examples.zh: 他是明知故犯，不能轻饶。
examples.en: He did it knowing it was wrong, so he can't be let off lightly.

examples.zh: 酒后开车是明知故犯。
examples.en: Drink-driving is breaking the law with your eyes open.

examples.zh: 犯错不可怕，可怕的是明知故犯。
examples.en: Making mistakes isn't the problem — doing wrong on purpose is.

meaning.en: Clusters of flowers and brocade; richly colourful and splendid.
meaning.zh: 花朵聚成团，锦缎堆成簇，形容五彩缤纷、繁华艳丽。

examples.zh: 节日的广场花团锦簇。
examples.en: On the holiday the square is a blaze of flowers.

examples.zh: 公园里花团锦簇，游人如织。
examples.en: The park is a riot of colour and packed with visitors.

examples.zh: 这篇文章写得花团锦簇，却缺乏内容。
examples.en: The essay is beautifully ornate but short on substance.

meaning.en: Sincere and deeply felt.
meaning.zh: 情意真挚恳切。

examples.zh: 他的发言情真意切，打动了在场的每一个人。
examples.en: His heartfelt speech moved everyone present.

examples.zh: 这封信写得情真意切。
examples.en: The letter is deeply sincere.

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，校长情真意切地嘱咐我们。
examples.en: At graduation, the head gave us some heartfelt advice.

meaning.en: A miracle cure; a panacea for any problem.
meaning.zh: 神奇有效的丹药，比喻能解决一切问题的好办法。

examples.zh: 学习外语没有什么灵丹妙药，只能多练。
examples.en: There's no magic bullet for learning a language — you just have to practise.

examples.zh: 降价不是解决销量问题的灵丹妙药。
examples.en: Price cuts aren't a cure-all for poor sales.

examples.zh: 这种保健品被吹成了灵丹妙药。
examples.en: This supplement has been hyped as a miracle cure.

usage.en: Object; often 没有灵丹妙药 / 不是灵丹妙药.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常用于否定句。

meaning.en: So frightened that one's hair stands on end.
meaning.zh: 毛发竖起，脊梁骨发冷，形容非常害怕。

equivalents: make one's hair stand on end

examples.zh: 半夜听到这种声音，真让人毛骨悚然。
examples.en: Hearing that sound in the middle of the night made my flesh crawl.

examples.zh: 这部恐怖片看得我毛骨悚然。
examples.en: The horror film sent shivers down my spine.

examples.zh: 案件的细节令人毛骨悚然。
examples.en: The details of the case are chilling.

usage.en: Predicate; often 令人毛骨悚然.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“令人毛骨悚然”。

natural: not live up to its name

meaning.en: Not living up to one's reputation or name.
meaning.zh: 名声或名义与实际不相符。

equivalents: not live up to its name

examples.zh: 这家网红餐厅名不副实。
examples.en: This internet-famous restaurant is overrated.

examples.zh: 所谓的“专家”其实名不副实。
examples.en: The so-called 'expert' doesn't live up to the title.

examples.zh: 这个“五星级”酒店有点名不副实。
examples.en: This 'five-star' hotel doesn't quite deserve the name.

usage.en: Predicate. Also written 名不符实.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作“名不符实”。

meaning.en: Blended into a seamless, harmonious whole.
meaning.zh: 融合成一个整体，不可分割。

examples.zh: 这座建筑与周围的山水浑然一体。
examples.en: The building blends seamlessly with the surrounding landscape.

examples.zh: 他的书法和画作浑然一体。
examples.en: His calligraphy and painting form a seamless whole.

examples.zh: 音乐和画面浑然一体，非常震撼。
examples.en: The music and visuals merge into one — stunning.

meaning.en: To look this way and that; to glance about nervously or hesitantly.
meaning.zh: 向左右两边看，形容东张西望，也形容犹豫观望。

examples.zh: 他站在路口左顾右盼，像在等人。
examples.en: He stood at the crossing looking this way and that, as if waiting for someone.

examples.zh: 上课时别左顾右盼。
examples.en: Don't keep looking around in class.

examples.zh: 投资者左顾右盼，迟迟不敢入市。
examples.en: Investors are hesitating on the sidelines, afraid to enter the market.

meaning.en: Overjoyed; jubilant.
meaning.zh: 形容非常高兴。

examples.zh: 孩子们欢天喜地地过新年。
examples.en: The children celebrated the New Year in high spirits.

examples.zh: 拿到录取通知书，他欢天喜地。
examples.en: He was over the moon when he got his offer letter.

examples.zh: 全村人欢天喜地迎接新娘。
examples.en: The whole village joyfully welcomed the bride.

meaning.en: Looking proper and up to standard; quite convincing.
meaning.zh: 形容达到一定标准，看起来很像样子。

examples.zh: 小家伙穿上西装，还挺像模像样的。
examples.en: The little lad looks quite the part in a suit.

examples.zh: 她第一次做菜，就做得像模像样。
examples.en: It was her first time cooking, but the meal was pretty decent.

examples.zh: 这个小作坊也搞得像模像样。
examples.en: Even this little workshop is run quite properly.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; casual. Also 有模有样.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，口语。也作“有模有样”。

meaning.en: Vast and boundless; (of talk) wide-ranging and unrestrained.
meaning.zh: 像大海一样辽阔，像天空一样空旷，形容大自然的广阔，也比喻想象或说话漫无边际。

examples.zh: 退一步海阔天空。
examples.en: Take a step back and the whole world opens up.

examples.zh: 我们几个海阔天空地聊了一晚上。
examples.en: We chatted about everything under the sun all evening.

examples.zh: 毕业后，他去了更海阔天空的世界。
examples.en: After graduating, he headed off into a wider world.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; 退一步海阔天空 is a common saying.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语；常说“退一步海阔天空”。

meaning.en: To be controlled by others.
meaning.zh: 被别人控制。

examples.zh: 关键技术掌握在自己手里，才不会受制于人。
examples.en: Only by mastering key technologies yourself can you avoid being at others' mercy.

examples.zh: 他欠了一大笔钱，处处受制于人。
examples.en: He owes a fortune and is at his creditors' mercy.

examples.zh: 能源依赖进口就会受制于人。
examples.en: Relying on imported energy leaves you dependent on others.

meaning.en: To clasp one's wrist and sigh, in regret or frustration.
meaning.zh: 用手握住手腕叹气，形容惋惜、愤慨。

examples.zh: 他英年早逝，令人扼腕叹息。
examples.en: His early death is a matter of deep regret.

examples.zh: 球队在最后一秒失分，球迷们扼腕叹息。
examples.en: The team conceded in the final second and the fans groaned in dismay.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会错过了，真让人扼腕叹息。
examples.en: Missing such a good opportunity is a real shame.

usage.en: Predicate; often 令人扼腕叹息. Formal.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“令人扼腕叹息”，书面语。

meaning.en: Able to take sole charge of an area of work.
meaning.zh: 单独承担一个方面的重任。

examples.zh: 经过几年锻炼，他已经能独当一面了。
examples.en: After a few years' experience, he can now run things on his own.

examples.zh: 她是能独当一面的项目经理。
examples.en: She's a project manager who can take full charge.

examples.zh: 年轻球员在这场比赛中独当一面。
examples.en: The young player carried the team in this match.

story.en: Zhang Liang told the King of Han that among his generals only Han Xin could be entrusted with great matters and 'take on one front alone' (独韩信可属大事，当一面).
story.zh: 《史记·留侯世家》：“而汉王之将独韩信可属大事，当一面。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“能独当一面”。

meaning.en: Filled with dread; jumpy with fear.
meaning.zh: 心里害怕，身上的肉也在跳，形容担心灾祸临头，十分害怕。

equivalents: have one's heart in one's mouth

examples.zh: 看着孩子在栏杆上爬，妈妈心惊肉跳。
examples.en: Watching her child climb on the railing, the mother's heart was in her mouth.

examples.zh: 电话铃一响，他就心惊肉跳。
examples.en: Every time the phone rings, he jumps.

examples.zh: 股市暴跌，让散户们心惊肉跳。
examples.en: The market crash left small investors jittery.
